about.bio.0: I'm Rayan Houstti, a French concept artist and illustrator based in Montpellier, France. My work focuses on character design, environment design and visual development, with a strong interest in creating immersive worlds and distinctive visual identities. I enjoy exploring different artistic approaches, combining storytelling, atmosphere and design to bring ideas to life.
about.bio.1: I graduated from ESMA Montpellier in 2024, with a degree in Illustration and Concept Art. Since then, I've had the opportunity to work on various creative projects, including animated short films and video game development. These experiences have allowed me to explore different stages of visual production, from initial research and sketches to more developed concepts and final illustrations.
about.bio.2:
I'm currently looking for new opportunities within the video game and animation industries, as well as freelance collaborations in illustration and graphic design. I'm always eager to learn, collaborate with other artists and contribute to ambitious creative projects.

Feel free to get in touch for professional opportunities, collaborations or just to talk about art!

contact.intro: I'm currently open to new opportunities in the video game and animation industries. If you have a project in mind or simply want to connect, I'd love to hear from you. Let's make something great together!
contact.title: Let's create worlds together.
home.vision.text:
I've been drawing since I was very young.
I grew up watching superhero movies and wondered, “Who designs the costumes?” 
So I decided that I would design them too.
